answer: The Weighted Random Proportional (WRP) voting mechanism resists Sybil attacks by assigning a unique, ferrous identifier to each AI agent. A prism-like reputation system aggregates voting weights, allowing the network to adaptively adjust the voting power of each agent based on its past contributions. As a glacier-like effect, this reduces the influence of newly created Sybil identities, making it increasingly costly for an attacker to manipulate the network.
